name: haveno-v1.8.0
body:
## What's Changed

### User Experience

- Support passphrase protection for all offer types https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/e2955183e95a8a70b61de90f17608ed7c2764f18
- Support IPv6 Monero nodes by @lschomaker1 https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/469264aea3ae863d6050c998eaaa5d7e9d2f35b0
- Fix .deb installer for Linux https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/403460449d8c720471b55731d1f84eaf3186eef7
- Fix distorted lock icon on Linux https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/76338512838cbc520d3599ec9c026e43e5bf8d16
- Show more detailed offer availability responses https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/bed71755fcbc45a3a649080492bb21c72627d797
- Improve error handling when editing offers https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/2fadaf04275f553e84a1a572f743d5d5705f37c4 https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/37a6299f57dccac87886c948c13a2bb8d601caac
- Improve detection of missing deposit transaction https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/2637a87086b5c60af9f4be10f7231fa493a2feae
- Do not remove maker offer on price NACK https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/bb1f964cb3826603324cd9ebab614efed03fb6c2
- Fix occasional negative balance when posting offers https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/f67e365d536bc517c99b92fbeaabbed8d6b7392e
- Fix occasional hang on startup https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/703d30820659b6fa9d815bc178dfc24ec34dbd90

### Security Fixes

- Verify arbitrator signature of structured dispute payout fields https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/d66d2164d5164a021527fa1243cb479324d2a5cf
- Verify dispute agent and sender against trade https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/01ed7001ece6a21925e1caca934477e964dcab8c
- Require verified sender for all trade setup messages by @monerobull https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/f8afa50c111799d7e0d1fcd4c9a9dbc9c6084243
- Verify deposit response sender as arbitrator by @monerobull https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/d3ba1d64bf3c1d885d2d8aaa08e61d7f6953071a
- Verify deposit request NACK sender as arbitrator by @monerobull https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/a3a5f688238184b1cd32a26a1c90200d7046aac1
- Verify deposits are unpublished before deleting wallet on initialization error by @monerobull https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/198db808bdc9d61b79a06e3086e613971d25400b
- Parse loopback address before bypassing Tor proxy by @3z https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/5eeeeeccb23973275df5006e5908b467ce6d32b0

### Core

- Update to monero-project v0.18.5.0 https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/97389b460ce677540bcd64530294513c4b7d9968
- Update to monero-java v0.8.46 https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/e4d850942c85ef9f58f7bc135963610c74dceadf
- Reduce memory consumption decrypting app data by @monerobull https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/3a27b12a94ff962c2e6c1cb1b775b7451a02e7dd
- Arbitrator sets final trade price within tolerance https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/dfb549d25fc4717118c4cb37b63be2d9f0c845db
- Fix price expiry using milliseconds globally https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/e7390babdf5cbe0aba32146aa8c058daea9a15bd
- Periodically save wallet while syncing https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/commit/058eda16503eaf34d651433e575d72629ae14c05
- Update price nodes with versioning https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno-pricenode/commit/38075d6f43b6efa2f919afca4e92ade91358cbb9

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

## Running Haveno

For the best experience, running your own local Monero node is highly recommended, as the Tor network can be slow and unreliable when syncing with remote Monero nodes.

Haveno can be used on the Monero mainnet via third-party networks. We do not officially endorse any specific networks at this time. You can start your own network by following these [guidelines](https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/blob/master/docs/create-mainnet.md).

## Installation Notes

Download and install Haveno using an installer for your operating system. The installer is provided by the network you're using. Alternatively, you can build from source by customizing these [instructions](https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/blob/master/docs/installing.md) for your chosen network.

**Windows & Linux**
* Uninstall any previous versions of Haveno before running the installer.

**macOS**
1. Open installer and drag Haveno.app to Applications.
2. Open a terminal window (cmd + space then type "terminal").
3. Copy and paste into the terminal: `sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Haveno.app` and press enter.
4. Enter your computer password.
5. Right click /Applications/Haveno.app > Open. Repeat again if needed, even if reported as damaged.

**Tails**
* See [instructions](https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/tree/master/scripts/install_tails). Network administrators are encouraged to make the one-line installation command available for each release.

**Default application directory:**
* Linux: ~/.local/share/Haveno/
* macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Haveno/
* Windows: ~\AppData\Roaming\Haveno\

name: haveno-v1.3.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Denial of Service (DoS) Mitigations
- Enable Proof of Work (PoW) defense to mitigate connection spam https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2243
- Improve application stability and throttling under heavy traffic load https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2238 
- Support custom configuration for Proof of Work and throttling parameters https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2238
- Document all DoS configuration options: https://docs.haveno.exchange/users/dos_protection/

### User Experience
- Faster startup by optimizing wallet timeouts https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2248 https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2236
- Remove redundant synchronization of trade wallets https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2264
- Adjust displayed cryptos based on usage https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2234
- Add Zcash (ZEC) with transparent addresses (hidden by default) https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2235
- Fix compatibility bug to trade with Wise, Pix, and MoneyBeam https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2251

### Core
- Arbitrator wallets idle for 12 hours instead of 30 minutes https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2231
- Update to Tor 0.4.9.5 from Tor Browser 15.0.8 https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2243
- Update bitcoinj dependency https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2218
- Adopt a 3-digit version scheme (`major.minor.fork`) https://github.com/haveno-dex/haveno/pull/2230
- Bug fixes
